C7^4.source: Vesel and Žerovnik (2002), Improved lower bound on the Shannon capacity of C7, Information Processing Letters 81(5), 277–282, DOI 10.1016/S0020-0190(01)00229-0
C7^4.open_check: Itty et al. (2026), arXiv:2607.21517 v2, §2, explicitly states alpha(C7^4) is unknown and only >=108 is known.
C7^4.witness_limit: The 2002 article reports 108 and displays a figure, but a machine-readable word list is not available in the checked public archive. We do not claim to reproduce that 108-word witness. Frozen local traditional witness is 100 words.
